$comment: Stage spec: enumeration — CONTENT enumeration of services mapped by EAS (JS/API extraction, directory/path, parameter discovery). 阶段重排 2026-06-09: 端口/服务前移到 EAS; 本阶段在已知服务上挖内容, 产出可测单元 = vuln_triage 分母. 见 docs/design/2026-06-09-active-stage-verify-first.md.
$comment_findings_allowed: Content-enumeration stage: the deliverable is js/api/dir/param coverage (testable units feeding vuln_triage), NOT vulnerabilities. submit_stage_deliverable drops any findings submitted here and tells the model to put discoveries in claims. Design 2026-06-15-recon-stage-findings-suppression.
$comment_host_aware: 2026-07-10 exact-origin contract: content enumeration (JS/DIR/PARAM/JSAPI) is keyed only by EAS-confirmed canonical scheme://host:port. A target URL, confirmed-open ports[].url, or explicit HTTP(S) service metadata can materialize an origin. Alive bare domain/IP, targets.http_status without scheme/port, unknown TCP service, closed/filtered port, and unknown/rootless class are excluded from the content denominator instead of becoming pending/not_applicable cells.
$comment_skip_dead_assets: Dead-asset denominator exclusion (design 2026-07-02-dead-asset-liveness-state §5.2): drop assets EAS confirmed dead (targets.liveness_state='dead') before exact-origin materialization so a dead host no longer forces JS/DIR/PARAM/JSAPI probing. EAS itself must NOT set this (it is the liveness-judging stage). An all-dead or no-exact-origin set is an authoritative zero content denominator; 'unreachable' is never dropped by liveness state alone (may be transient).
$comment_freshness_window: Enumeration only projects exact-origin technique_outcomes collected at or after the current stage start. If the stage-start cutoff is unavailable, outcome projection is skipped rather than falling back to older rows from the same session. Business discovery tables remain raw findings and never close the four Enumeration axes.

on_fail.reason: claim evidence ids are optional; cited ids, if any, must be real
hints: omit evidence_ids unless a real ledger id is explicitly available

on_fail.reason: finding evidence ids are optional; cited ids, if any, must be real
hints: omit evidence_refs unless a real ledger id is explicitly available

gate_rules.$comment_derive: Enumeration is current-run evidence authoritative on the exact Web Origin × four-axis matrix. found/checked_empty ownership is unchanged and strict: JS=browser_collect_js_api, JSAPI/PARAM=js_extract_apis, DIR=route_probe_paths. blocked has a separate narrow producer matrix: enum_preflight_web_origins + enumeration_transport_blocked may close JS/DIR/PARAM/JSAPI; route_probe_paths + dir_probe_recovery_exhausted may close DIR only; browser_collect_js_api + enumeration_collection_recovery_exhausted may close JS/JSAPI/PARAM only. Every terminal projection requires fresh evidence bound to the current organization, authorized target, exact origin, technique, outcome, and evidence id. Browser runtime discovery otherwise leaves JSAPI/PARAM partial until same-set static extraction; ordinary error/partial stay non-terminal. Model-authored blocked/not_applicable cannot close a cell, and raw non-web hosts are excluded instead of being promoted to origin-level not_applicable.

on_fail.reason: content enumeration incomplete: some alive in-scope services were not fully enumerated (js/api / dir / param)
hints: for EVERY EAS-confirmed live web root, take GOLISH-ENUM-JSAPI (browser_collect_js_api -> mandatory same-set js_extract_apis), GOLISH-ENUM-DIR (route_probe_paths once after JS/API landing with target_id + base_url; omit wordlist_recursion_depth for the finite default that runs DB/observed/curated parent probes plus one local/built-in root wordlist pass; explicit 1..6 recursion is opt-in and any candidate-generation limit remains partial), and GOLISH-ENUM-PARAM (browser observations remain raw/partial until same-set js_extract_apis folds request/query/form parameters and static param_hints) to a terminal state

do NOT hand-write coverage cells: fresh exact-origin producer outcomes close found/checked_empty; trusted current-target evidence may close blocked only through enum_preflight_web_origins transport preflight, route_probe_paths DIR recovery exhaustion, or browser_collect_js_api JS/JSAPI/PARAM recovery exhaustion. A producer-reported persisted blocked/recovery_exhausted cell is terminal and must not be retried. Raw non-web/rootless hosts never enter the denominator; raw business rows and deliverable prose cannot close cells; submit coverage=[]

$comment_expected_techniques: 枚举阶段内容技术（GOLISH-ENUM-*，登记于 technique_taxonomy.json）。阶段重排 2026-06-09：端口/服务已在 EAS 做，本阶段只挖内容。coverage_complete 对每个存活服务逐类核终态；产出可测单元是 vuln_triage total_units 分母来源。
$comment_stage_run: stage_run fan-out (design 2026-06-13-stage-run-fanout §3.2): specialist = the per-org sub-agent stage_run fans out (enumeration → enumerator, the ACTIVE content-enumeration specialist split from Pentester, mirroring prober for EAS); coverage_axis = the human-readable technique columns StageRunView renders per org row (one per expected technique: js / dir / param / jsapi).
$comment_team_scheduler: 2026-07-16 downstream convergence: every company uses one durable Company Controller with the frozen Enumerator wrapper/worklist authority. Child delegation does not alter exact-origin scope, evidence ownership, or deterministic coverage closure.
$comment_min_invocations: No hard tool floor. HTTP probing and service fingerprinting belong to external_attack_surface; Enumeration completeness is the fresh exact-origin JS/DIR/PARAM/JSAPI technique_outcome matrix, with found/empty backed by real evidence and error/partial left unfinished.
